title: Ride hailing (driver matching)
summary: Track drivers' locations and match each ride request to a nearby available driver.
functional: Drivers report their location every few seconds
Riders request a ride and get the nearest suitable driver
Track the trip in real time
non_functional: Location shown to riders is at most a few seconds old
No driver is offered two rides at once

drivers_online_peak.why: Drivers online at the busiest moment globally.

location_interval_seconds.why: Each driver app sends a location every 4 s.

location_bytes.why: Driver id, coordinates, heading, speed and timestamp.

searches_per_ride.why: Nearby-driver searches per request, including retries and ETA refreshes.

geo_index_replicas.why: In-memory geo index copies per region for availability.
